jupyterToken.description: Authentication token for the Jupyter server. Generated automatically by start-jpy.sh and saved in environment. Both 'jupyterToken' (camelCase) and 'jupyter_token' (snake_case) are accepted; the resolver honors whichever is set.

jupyter_token.description: Alias for jupyterToken (snake_case form, parity with Hermes env-var config).

jupyterUrl.description: URL of the Jupyter Lab server. Default: http://127.0.0.1:8888. Both 'jupyterUrl' and 'jupyter_url' are accepted.

notebookDir.description: Physical directory path where notebooks are stored on the Jupyter server. Used with defaultNotebook to auto-increment notebook names (e.g., ~/.openclaw/jupyter_home). Relative paths are resolved from Jupyter root.

defaultNotebook.description: Default notebook name used when creating new notebooks without explicit path. Defaults to 'Untitled' if not specified. Auto-increments to Untitled-1, Untitled-2, etc. if files exist.

timeoutMs.description: Request timeout in milliseconds for Jupyter operations. Default: 30000 (30 seconds). Increase for slow networks or long-running operations.

collabMode.description: Y.js CRDT co-editing policy. Mirrors the Hermes plugin's JUPYTER_COLLAB_MODE. 'auto' (default) probes the server once and uses CRDT when jupyter-collaboration is reachable; 'on' requires CRDT; 'off' forces the Contents-API (whole-file PUT) path. Requires the optional yjs npm dependency at runtime; the plugin loads and runs without it.
